ticket.subject: Webhooks failing with 502 since yesterday
ticket.body: Our endpoint stopped receiving webhook events; 502 in the delivery log.

action.body:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for reaching out about "Webhooks failing with 502 since yesterday".

Webhook deliveries fail when your endpoint returns a non-2xx status or takes longer than 10 seconds. A 502 usually comes from a proxy or load balancer in front of your endpoint. Return 200 right away and process the event in the background.

I checked our logs: 2 matching events from webhooks, most recently "delivery failed: upstream returned 502 after 10.0s" (request req_web0180).

More detail: Webhook deliveries failing with 502 or timeouts (KB-101).

If this doesn't sort it out, reply here and we'll keep digging.

Relay Support

evidence: doc KB-101: Webhook deliveries failing with 502 or timeouts
logs: 2 hits for service:webhooks AND status_code:502

human.notes: Correct article, uses the log evidence, actionable.

More detail: Password reset emails not arriving (KB-107).
